Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring an analysis of how school districts use school days.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the definition of school day; and creating a newsection.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The joint legislative audit and reviewcommittee shall conduct an analysis of how school districts use schooldays. The analysis must include: (a) How school districts define classroom time, nonclassroom time,instructional time, noninstructional time, and any other definitions ofhow the school day is divided or used; (b) Estimates of time in each category; (c) When noninstructional hours occur; (d) How noninstructional hours are used including how much of thenoninstructional time is devoted to professional development for thepurposes of teacher and principal evaluation training or common corestate standards training; and (e) The extent to which the use of each category of time isidentified or defined in collective bargaining agreements. (2) To the extent data is not available at the statewide level, the p. 1 SSB 5588joint legislative audit and review committee may use case studies orother methods to conduct the analysis. (3) The joint legislative audit and review committee shall submita report of its findings to the education committees of the legislatureby December 1, 2014.
